get_refresh_status. Works for companies already in the index and for domains we
have never seen, which is how you add one.

tools.description:
Returns what has happened at the companies THIS KEY ALREADY WATCHES, since the
last time you asked.

This is a personal inbox, not a view of the index. Use it when the question is
about continuity — "anything new since last time", "what did I miss", "what fired
on my watchlist". If the question is w

tools.name: list_watchlists
tools.description:
Lists the watchlists on this account: named sets of companies, usually one per
client or project, with how many companies each holds and what has been spent on it.

A watchlist is not a watch. Nothing in it is scanned until companies are added or
a scan is requested. For a company you want followed

tools.name: manage_watchlist
tools.description:
Creates a watchlist, or renames, archives or restores one.

Make one list per client or project, so each can be scanned and read on its own.
Creating a list costs nothing and scans nothing. Archiving hides a list and keeps
everything in it; restore brings it back. Add companies with
update_watchlist

tools.name: update_watchlist_companies
tools.description:
Adds companies to a watchlist or removes them, by domain.

tools.description:
Scans the companies in a watchlist, or cancels a scan in progress.

tools.description:

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "find_company" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Finds a company in the BounceWatch index by name, and returns its domain — which is what every other company tool needs. Use this whenever you have a company's …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_watches · Private data: search_companies, watch_company · Public sink: watch_company · Destructive: update_watchlist_companies, scan_watchlist, get_watchlist_signals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_watches · Private data: search_companies, watch_company · Public sink: watch_company · Destructive: update_watchlist_companies, scan_watchlist, get_watchlist_signals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_company_signals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
